== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Cloudships are various types of aerial vessels used for transportation, combat, and habitation. They operate by utilizing specialized [[scripts]] and [[constructs]] to manipulate [[wind]] and [[cloud madra]], often resting upon a base of shimmering or colored clouds. These ships are fueled by different energy sources, including stored [[madra]] in [[crystal flasks]], ambient [[vital aura]], or powerful [[rainbow madra]]. While some vessels are small, such as lifeboats or simple rafts, others are massive enough to serve as mobile headquarters or passenger ships capable of carrying thousands of people. A specialized, larger-[[scale]] version known as a [[cloud fortress]] functions more like a permanent flying island or mobile base. The technology and speed of these ships vary significantly, ranging from slow-moving caravans that require frequent refueling to high-speed imperial models equipped with propulsion tubes and [[wind]] [[constructs]]. They are used for diverse purposes, including evacuations, traveling to tournaments, and serving as the foundations for entire cities or sects.}}
